WATCH: Zelensky confirms that Ukraine carried out the sea-drone attack off Libya, saying the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk and a Ka-27 helicopter destroyed. He called it "an exemplary Ukrainian operation in response to Russia's war" and thanked the SBU and other defense forces. He said seven Ukrainian-made sea drones were used and that, "despite all the enemy's efforts to counter them," the Merkury was sunk.

NEW: Western intelligence agencies believe Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite into space before the end of 2026. The satellite, reportedly named Sputnik-S, has allegedly been stored near Moscow for years and could be launched as early as December. Germany’s military has warned that a nuclear detonation in space could disable large numbers of satellites, disrupting GPS, communications, banking and power systems. U.S. military intelligence says there would be few effective countermeasures once the weapon enters orbit. Russia denies the allegations, calling them part of a propaganda campaign.
